# generated by tools/crosscheck.py gen - expected values come from the ROM data
symbols flashback.noi

echo self-test mode: button 1 is held at boot so the ROM runs its
echo diagnostics instead of going straight to the intro
hold 1
run 30
hold none
expect self_test == 1 w1

echo game logic: the ported interpreter replays the recorded demo and is
echo compared with the original engine frame by frame
waituntil logic_frame >= 505 12000
run 5
expect logic_frames_ok >= 504
expect logic_first_bad == 504
expect logic_bad_op == 0 w1

echo boot: level object tables are built, then the logos cutscene (0x40) starts
waituntil fmv_tick >= 2 900
run 10
expect game_state == 0 w1
expect fmv_active == 1 w1
expect is_pal == 0 w1
expectvdp display 1
waituntil fmv_tick >= 348 2000
screenshot shots/sms/cut_40_348.ppm
print fmv_tick
waituntil fmv_tick >= 677 2000
screenshot shots/sms/cut_40_677.ppm
print fmv_tick

echo logos play to their natural end: 818 ticks, 592 uploads (host decode)
waituntil seq_pos == 1 2000 w1
expect last_clip_ticks == 818
expect last_clip_uploads == 592
expect fmv_active == 1 w1
waituntil fmv_tick >= 630 3000
screenshot shots/sms/cut_0D_630.ppm
print fmv_tick
waituntil fmv_tick >= 860 3000
screenshot shots/sms/cut_0D_860.ppm
print fmv_tick

echo timing: after 1200 real frames of the intro the stream is still in sync (bounded lag)
waituntil fmv_tick >= 1100 400
expect ticks_behind <= 8
run 100
expect ticks_behind <= 8
expect fmv_active == 1 w1
print fmv_tick

echo button 1 skips the rest of the intro to the title screen
tap 1
waituntil game_state == 1 120 w1
run 5
expectvdp display 1
expectcolors 8
screenshot shots/sms/title.ppm

echo game logic: each level's live object table is built on the Z80 and
echo compared with the original engine (object count, active objects, checksum)
waituntil pge_loaded == 1 900 w1
expect 0xC013 == 107
expect 0xC00D == 26
expect 0xC007 == 47901

echo simulated gameplay: the title screen starts level 1 through its
echo own cutscene, then the ported logic drives the sprite renderer
waituntil game_state == 1 12000 w1
run 20
hold 2
run 20
hold none
waituntil game_state == 2 2000 w1
run 120
expect sim_room == 27 w1
expect sim_sprites >= 4 w1
expectvdp display 1
expectcolors 8
screenshot shots/sms/sim_gate.ppm
echo the controller drives the simulation: holding a direction moves Conrad
expect 0xC02E == 48
hold right
run 400
hold none
run 20
expect 0xC02E > 48
expect sim_sprites >= 3 w1
echo run + up jumps: the engine never sees a diagonal, so the jump
echo comes from the run modifier with up, not up plus a direction
hold 1+up
run 100
hold none
run 40
expect 0xC02E > 103
pause
run 20
waituntil game_state == 1 120 w1
run 5
